assignment_description:
⍞ Materials: Heart Of A Samurai

➜ INTRO
In 1841, a real fourteen-year-old Japanese fisherman named Manjiro survived a shipwreck and set in motion one of history's most unlikely adventures. At a time when Japan's borders were sealed to all outsiders, this humble fisherman's son crossed oceans and cultures. Heart of a Samurai is a work of historical fiction, drawing on the documented events of Manjiro's life to bring to life this extraordinary true story.

➜ READ, NARRATE, & DISCUSS
See Planning & Prep for alternate reading schedules. The pages listed will complete sections one and two of the book during the term.
Ch.1 p.1-8

➜ LOCATE (Optional)
Look for Shikoku, Japan, on a map or globe.

➜ VIEW
∞ Image Link: Shikoku, Japan


Additional Notes

────────────────────

Teachers may also want to read the historical notes on p.278-281 and share parts with students throughout the term as time allows.
assignment_teachersNote:
★ TEACHER NOTE
There is a helpful glossary of terms on p.283. If students have not been introduced to a glossary before and/or will be reading this book on their own, this is a good opportunity to point out how a glossary works. Remind students that they do not need to look up every word they do not know—most will make sense in context and will not be vital to the story. However, the glossary is available if there are words they (or you) would like to learn the meanings of.
